title: FHA, VA and HomeReady Addenda Add-On to a Closing and Funding Redraw
content:
Program addenda add-on for a Closing and Funding redraw, by the loan program of the borrower's Mortgage Loan File:

| Loan program | Program addenda add-on (USD) |
|---|---|
| Larkspur FHA 30-Year Fixed | 10.00 |
| Larkspur VA 30-Year Fixed | 10.00 |
| Larkspur HomeReady 30-Year Fixed | 5.00 |
| Larkspur Conventional 30-Year Fixed | none |
| Larkspur Conventional 15-Year Fixed | none |
| Larkspur High-Balance Conforming 30-Year Fixed | none |
| Larkspur Jumbo 30-Year Fixed | none |

**Rule restated.** Where the program is the Larkspur FHA 30-Year Fixed or the Larkspur VA 30-Year Fixed, the add-on is 10.00; where it is the Larkspur HomeReady 30-Year Fixed, it is 5.00; otherwise there is none.
